models.image_id: not_applicable: execution route does not produce a Modal image digest
models.output_shape: mmCIF, chain A designed binder and chain B fixed target
models.cost_basis: s/design and $/design use client wall seconds; runner_s/design uses provider-reported runner wall seconds. The cost uses the reference GPU-H100 rate of $0.00125 per second from skills/claude-binder-lane/reference-gpu-rates-2026-08-23.json. That rate was read from one provider usage export and is not a Modal rate. fal bills runner uptime, which client wall brackets from above.
models.weights_upstream_source: https://files.ipd.uw.edu/pub/rfd3/rfd3_foundry_2025_12_01_remapped.ckpt. The deployed application downloads that URL, hashes the file and refuses to start unless the digest matches, at fal_rfdiffusion3_app.py:48-106 and :301-303. The digest below is therefore the digest of the publisher's bytes, verified on the deployment.
models.production_flags_evidence: A provider canary measured the production configuration on GPU-H100 with max_concurrency 1 and keep_alive 0. Configure and qualify an application that your account controls before dispatch.
models.container_build_evidence: The toolcheck probe reached the built environment and reported its device, torch build and CUDA runtime: torch 2.13.0+cu130, CUDA 13.0, cuDNN 92000, on NVIDIA H100 80GB HBM3.
models.package_imports_evidence: The same probe imported torch, resolved the CUDA device and loaded the checkpoint before reporting its digest and byte count.
models.measurement_source: End-to-end canary run on 2026-08-23 against the campaign's primary target. Three backbones ran in one batch at seed 3 and exited successfully. The receipt is canary/rf3/receipt.json.

models.weights_upstream_source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/dauparas/ProteinMPNN/8907e6671bfbfc92303b5f79c4b5e6ce47cdef57/vanilla_model_weights/v_48_020.pt. The deployed application downloads that URL, hashes the file and refuses it unless the digest matches, at fal_mpnn_app.py:39-103 and :224. models.output_shape: mmCIF, chain A binder and chain B target, with PAE and pLDDT arrays
models.cost_basis: s/design and $/design use client wall seconds; runner_s/design uses provider-reported runner wall seconds. models.weights_sha256: not_applicable: the deployed application resolves its weights as HuggingFace repository snapshots at pinned revisions and reports no digest for any weight file. RepoManifest carries repo, revision, bytes_on_disk and file_count and no digest field, and the only sha256 the application reports is for ccd.pkl, a chemical component dictionary rather than model weights.
models.weights_revision_source: resolved_snapshots in each fold response, which the application writes from the snapshot it actually loaded. The same two pins appear in the profile's model_revision for this adapter.
models.production_flags_evidence: A provider canary measured the configuration on GPU-H100 with max_concurrency 1 and keep_alive 300. The adapter owns num_loops, num_sampling_steps, and num_diffusion_samples at module scope. Configure and qualify an application that your account controls before dispatch.
models.container_build_evidence: The preflight probe reached the built environment and reported cuda_visible true, the data mount writable, the venv marker present and uv 0.9.22. Each fold response then reports the worker environment it ran in: {"gpu_count": 1, "python_version": "3.12.12", "torch_cuda_version": "12.6", "torch_version": "2.7.1+cu126"}
models.package_imports_evidence: Each fold response reports the transformers build it imported, {"commit_id": "3a8956fb4d4ea16b0ec8e71deef2c2909b6a5cbf", "url": "https://github.com/Biohub/transformers.git", "version": "4.57.6"}, and the adapter manifest it loaded, sha256 7aa63a9a2f05a84361c0f554fc9a3cb87db5220f88ab240839f997bad00be236.
models.measurement_source: End-to-end canary run on 2026-08-23. Each of the three ProteinMPNN sequences was folded against the campaign's primary target at seed 0, exit 0. The responses are canary/ef2fold/canary-bb*/response.json.

Record a digest of the ESMFold2-Fast weight files as the deployment holds them. The application cannot report one today: it resolves biohub/ESMFold2-Fast and biohub/ESMC-6B as HuggingFace snapshots and its RepoManifest carries no digest field. Obtaining one needs a new endpoint that hashes the resolved snapshot, and deploying it forces a full environment rebuild.
Read the settled billed seconds for this canary from the fal billing page. The $/design here is derived from client wall seconds at the measured rate, not from a billing receipt.
models.exit_code_note: exit_code 0 is the code of the attempt that produced each recorded output. 1 earlier attempt(s) failed first and are recorded in failed_attempts. Every one was retried and the retry produced the output above.
